Black Wake Campaign // Western Everon

Dead Signal

Russian radar stations, fuel nodes, supply depots, convoys, and rocket artillery are feeding the western corridor. The Regiment will blind the network, cut the flow, intercept the convoys, and kill the battery.

Open Live IntelView Role Priority

Mission Overview

This mission is open to the Regiment. Patreon members receive priority access to specialist positions and the live intel dashboard.

Mission Type

Network Interdiction

Destroy supply crates, fuel barrels, radar generators, and rocket artillery while preventing convoys from keeping enemy bases alive.

Main Threat

Radar + Fire Support

Enemy radar positions protect the corridor. Buratino / Grad-style rocket systems are the major escalation threat.

Player Focus

Recon + Assault

Drone recon identifies positions. Infantry clears. Engineers destroy. Armor provides limited support.

Area of Operations

Build the mission around these connected positions so the enemy network feels coherent.

Lamentin HarborFuel barrels, containers, warehouses, and two fuel trucks.
Le MouleRadar/generator position, convoy route, and one rocket artillery threat.
SawmillMain supply crate depot. Destroy crates and recover intel if found.
VilleneuveFortified base/outpost with radar and enemy vehicle presence.
Redon / Humboldt HillNorthern radar towers, overwatch, armor, and air support trigger zone.
BellevueSecondary rocket artillery / Buratino position.

Event Form Copy

Copy this into the Regiment GM Event Form.

Mission Title: OPERATION: DEAD SIGNAL — Black Wake Campaign Short Tagline: Blind the radar. Cut the fuel. Kill the battery. Long Description: Russian forces on western Everon are being sustained by a connected support network across Lamentin, Le Moule, Villeneuve, Redon, Humboldt Hill, Sawmill, and Bellevue. Radar towers and generators are feeding enemy awareness. Sawmill crates are supplying fortified bases. Lamentin Harbor is fueling convoy traffic, armor, and air response. Two Buratino / Grad-style rocket systems are positioned to punish U.S. movement if left operational. The U.S. task force will conduct a multi-objective interdiction mission. Recon will identify radar, convoy, and launcher positions. Infantry will clear fortified outposts. Engineers will disable generators, destroy supply crates, and destroy or capture fuel assets. Armor and vehicles will provide limited support while the main force cuts the enemy network objective by objective. Mission Style: Combined arms / recon / demolition / convoy interdiction / radar sabotage / limited armor / optional controlled PvPvE Patreon Priority Roles: Drone Recon Specialist, Recon Lead, Armor Crew, Engineer/Demo Lead, Logistics/Convoy Lead, Mission Commander General Roles: Infantry, AT, medic, transport driver, convoy security, automatic rifleman, assault teams Primary Objectives: OBJ ALPHA — Sawblade: destroy Sawmill supply crates. OBJ BRAVO — Black Fuel: destroy Lamentin Harbor fuel stockpiles and fuel trucks. OBJ CHARLIE — Dead Wire South: disable radar/generator positions at Villeneuve and Le Moule. OBJ DELTA — High Mirror: disable Redon and Humboldt Hill radar/air support nodes. OBJ ECHO — Broken Hammer: disable Buratino / Grad-style rocket artillery at Le Moule and Bellevue. Win Condition: Radar disabled, fuel destroyed, supplies burned, convoys intercepted, rocket battery neutralized, intel recovered, and U.S. force extracted or holding final position.
